fusions.name: Split Hatchet
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that splits into 2 heads flying apart; each head deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Crossroads Cleave
fusions.desc: A splitting chop that deals 13 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target branch out to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Longer Haft
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Splinter Off
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a splinter of the blow leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
